instruction:
Read the Standard Ebooks information page for Pride and Prejudice without opening the book or downloading files. Report the author, displayed word count, estimated reading time and reading-ease score with its accompanying difficulty label. State the novel's original publication year as given in the description. Keep the site's reading estimate separate from the historical publication fact, report the metadata shown at run time, and cite the page.

Stopping condition: Stop when the five requested metadata/publication fields are correctly labelled and cited to the book information page.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.description: Evaluate if the agent correctly reports the author of the book (Jane Austen) as found on the information page. Full credit if reported correctly, OR if the agent clearly reports that the website is inaccessible.

Evaluate if the agent correctly reports the displayed word count from the page's metadata. Full credit if the reported word count matches what is shown on the page at run time, OR if the agent clearly reports that the website or information is inaccessible.

Evaluate if the agent correctly reports the estimated reading time from the page's metadata. Full credit if the reported reading time matches what is shown on the page at run time, OR if the agent clearly reports that the website or information is inaccessible.

items.criterion: Report the reading-ease score and difficulty label
items.description: Evaluate if the agent correctly reports both the reading-ease score and its accompanying difficulty label from the metadata. Full credit if both the numerical score and the label (e.g., 'easy', 'moderate') are provided as shown at run time, OR if the agent clearly reports that the website or information is inaccessible.

Evaluate if the agent reports the novel's original publication year specifically as it is given in the book's description. Full credit if accurately reported as shown at run time, OR if the agent clearly reports that the website or information is inaccessible.

items.criterion: Separate reading estimates from historical facts
items.description: Evaluate if the agent clearly separates the site's reading estimates (word count, time, reading-ease) from the historical publication fact in its output, as requested. Full credit for clear separation, or if the agent reported the site was inaccessible and could not fetch the data.
Evaluate if the agent provides the source URL to the Standard Ebooks information page used to gather the metadata.

items.criterion: Constraint: Do not open book or download files
items.description: Evaluate if the agent strictly adhered to the constraint of gathering information from the information page without opening the actual book content or downloading any ebook files. Full credit if constraints are respected.
